title: Adding a second company in Settings › Add company starts its own onboarding: locked, the company step done, an empty chart and no tax codes (nothing copied from the first company or a default); the app opens its onboarding page
evidence: onboarding note 1, chart choice hidden true; new company locked true, pending chart,tax,banks,imports,team; its accounts 0, tax codes 0; page after creating onboarding

title: The second company’s chart template and tax codes are its own: the first company’s accounts and tax codes are unchanged, and the second company gets exactly what its own file says
evidence: first company before {"accounts":"44","taxCodes":"1","bankAccounts":"2"} after {"accounts":"44","taxCodes":"1","bankAccounts":"2"}, codes ON-HST; second company {"accounts":"44","taxCodes":"1","bankAccounts":"2"}, codes BC-GST; tax accounts pointing to the other company 0

title: Onboarding is per company in the browser: the finished first company opens Home without locks; the second company opens its onboarding with locked modules
evidence: first company opens dashboard (locked false); second company opens onboarding (locked true)

title: The server enforces it for every way a company is created: a company created with onboarding gets no pre-filled chart or starter tax codes even when the request asks for the default chart; without onboarding (API, platform test companies) the default chart is unchanged
The owner archives a company: it leaves the owner’s company list, cannot be opened (any request with it is refused), and is listed under Archived companies; its records are untouched
evidence: archive 200; in company list false; in archived list true; opening it 403 company_forbidden; archiving again 409 company_already_archived; active/archived 0/1; journal lines 2/30000/30000 (before 2/30000/30000)

title: Only the owner can archive or restore: a Company Admin gets 403, a person who is not a member or an unknown id gets 404; once archived, the Company Admin no longer sees it and nobody can be invited to it
evidence: Company Admin archiving 403; platform owner (not a member) 404; unknown id 404; Company Admin sees it before true, after archiving false, opening it 403, restoring it 403; inviting to the archived company 403 invitation_unavailable

title: Restore brings the company back to the list with the same records; it can be opened again
evidence: restore 200; in list true; opens 200; journal lines 2/30000/30000; restoring again 409; audit company.archived,company.restored

title: In the browser: Account & Access › Actions › Archive, confirm; the company leaves the table and appears under Archived companies; Restore brings it back
evidence: after Archive: in the company table {"pages":1,"here":0,"anywhere":0}, active 0; after Restore active 1; page errors none

title: A company owner can no longer delete directly: operations/company-delete answers 409 “done by Tegh support”, and the company is untouched
evidence: 409 company_delete_by_request: "Permanent deletion is done by Tegh support. Send a deletion request from Account & Access; you can archive the company now."

title: The deletion request checks name, password, backup and reason; a valid request archives the company, waits as pending, and emails Tegh support; a second request is refused
evidence: wrong name 409, wrong password 403, no backup 409, no reason 422; valid 201; duplicate 409 deletion_request_pending; request pending/r159-owner-muycu1kw@gate.test/1; company active 0; emails to Tegh support 1

title: Only the platform owner sees and decides requests: the company owner gets 403 on the support inbox; the platform owner sees the request with the amount of records it would remove
evidence: owner on the inbox 403; platform owner sees pending, from r159-owner-muycu1kw@gate.test, {"tables":20,"rows":124,"invoices":1,"bills":0,"journalEntries":1}

title: Rejecting needs a note; a rejected request keeps the company (archived, restorable) and emails the owner; the owner can then restore it
evidence: reject without note 422; reject 200; request rejected; owner emailed 1; archived list shows rejected; deciding again 409

title: Cancelling: the owner cancels a pending request (the company stays archived); restoring a company cancels its pending request
evidence: cancel 200 → cancelled, company active 0; restore with a pending request 200 (cancelled 1) → cancelled, active 1

title: Approving needs the exact company name and the platform owner’s password; then the company is deleted: no row left in any company table, a deletion log naming the request, the request approved with its record counts, and the owner emailed
evidence: wrong name 409; wrong password 403; approve 200; company rows 0; left behind {}; deletion log names request true; request approved/1; owner emailed 1

title: In the browser: the owner sends a deletion request from Account & Access; the company leaves the list and shows “waiting for Tegh support”; the platform owner approves it on Platform Owner Home and the company is gone
evidence: owner sees "R159 Epsilon muycu1kw Oct 1, 2026 r159-owner-muycu1kw@gate.test Deletion requested · waiting for Tegh support Actions"; after approval company rows 0, left behind {}; page errors none
